geometry_edits.rationale: Promote the primary mass into a clearer curved datum that can organize the frontage and section.
Slightly intensify the bend so the form has a more readable dominant gesture.
Push the overhang to sharpen the public threshold and produce a more legible street-facing ground response.
Align the carved void to the verified access side so it reads as a public court/entry seam rather than an inward-only cut.

graph_edits.rationale: Strengthen the dominant gesture into a more legible continuous curve so the mass reads as one spatial rule rather than a box with incidental clipping.
Increase the bend slightly to make the primary massing gesture clearer across all views.
Use the cantilever to create a more explicit ground-level seam or undercut at the access side rather than a sealed frontage.
Keep the public void aligned to the verified access side so the open-space figure reads as an intentional threshold, not an internal subtraction.

rationale: The candidate reads as a coherent compact mass in most views, but the form logic is not yet fully aligned with the neighborhood-living brief. The dominant body is legible and contained within the parcel, but the section is awkward: the top cut/void feels more like an internal notch than a clearly public ground response, and the mass reads somewhat as a generic stepped block rather than an active street building. The blue access edge is acknowledged only weakly; the facade/ground condition does not produce a strong entrance seam or court aligned to that frontage. The four views are generally consistent, so it is not a view-coherence failure, but the form still needs a clearer public threshold and a more program-led section. The silhouette is acceptable as an early massing move, yet the stepped/cut condition is not particularly purposeful for this program.

reference_assessments.mismatch_warning: More campus/community-center than compact neighborhood living; the composition is broader and more dispersed than this site likely wants.
reference_assessments.transferable_principle: Low-rise neighborhood composition with a carved central open space and connected wings; useful as a precedent for a public court and articulated mass hierarchy.

reference_assessments.mismatch_warning: Too pavilion-like and visually light for the current candidate’s heavier stepped mass; avoid copying the flat simple box literally.
reference_assessments.transferable_principle: Single primary low-rise volume with a clear entry setback/canopy and a compact street-facing presence; useful for active edge and simple dominant mass.

warnings: Public threshold on the verified frontage is under-articulated.
Sectional logic does not yet strongly express neighborhood-living occupancy or active ground.
The mass risks reading as a generic stacked block rather than a clear street building with a public seam.
